title: Scaffold Rust crate
description: Create Cargo.toml (name amp, version 0.0.1, edition 2021, license MIT) and an empty src/lib.rs in the workspace root.

title: Implement amp library in src/lib.rs
description: Define pub struct Amp { version: u8, argc: u8, buf: Vec<u8>, pos: usize }, pub const AMP_VERSION: u8 = 1, pub fn amp_encode(argv: &[&str]) -> Vec<u8>, pub fn amp_decode(msg: &mut Amp, buf: &[u8]), pub fn amp_decode_arg(msg: &mut Amp) -> Vec<u8>. Use u32::from_be_bytes/to_be_bytes for the length fields; header byte is (version << 4) | argc.

title: Port tests/test.c to tests/test.rs
description: Encode ["some", "stuff", "here"], decode header and assert version == 1 and argc == 3, decode the three args and assert they equal b"some", b"stuff", b"here"; print ok.

title: Build and run cargo test until green
description: Run cargo build and cargo test in the workspace; fix any compile errors or test failures without weakening the ported assertions.

title: Verify byte-exact round trip and clean output
description: Add a test asserting the encoded buffer equals the expected byte sequence (header 0x13 followed by u32be lengths and payloads) and that cargo test runs without warnings.
